title: Marvel Partners With Kadokawa for Upcoming Manga Projects
content: Manga creator tokitokoro ( Lynx, River in Me, Jeff the Land Shark ) confirmed on X/Twitter on Saturday that Marvel Comics is partnering with Kadokawa for upcoming manga adaptations.
author: ANN

title: KonoSuba – God's blessing on this wonderful world! 4 Anime Reveals Staff, 2027 Debut
content: "Colorful," the 10th anniversary event for the KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!! anime, revealed on Sunday the fourth season of the anime, titled KonoSuba – God's blessing on this wonderful world! 4 , will air in 2027.

title: hololive Birmingham Concert Screening on September 17
content: Tickets are available for a screening of the concert film hololive English 4th Concert -Serendipity- on Thursday September 17 at Cineworld Birmingham NEC . Attendees can register for a place at https://www.serendipityscreening.com/ .

title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Yotsuba Succession Arc Anime Film Opens in Malaysia on August 6
content: Malaysian cinema chain GSC Movies revealed on Wednesday that Odex 's screening of The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc - ( Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei: Yotsuba Keishō-hen ) anime film in Malaysia will open on August 6. The film opened in Japan on May 8.

title: You and Idol Precure Film Opens in Taiwan on August 21
content: The film opened in Japan in September 2025. It sold 283,000 tickets and earned 346 million yen (about US$2.35 million) in its first three days. The film's story is set on Aiai Island during the Super Miracle Idol Festival, the #1 idol festival in the universe.
author: ANN
